paragraphs: R' Akiva ben Dosa. In the time of R' Meir. Heilprin cites Rav Sherira Gaon's Epistle as transmitted in Yuḥasin. The printed Epistle reads Yaakov ben Dosa, with Akiva ben Dosa attested in the apparatus. See above, R' Yaakov ben Dosa.
